definitions.explanation: Describes the natural process of a memory becoming less clear or vivid over time. Used for personal memories, collective memory, and historical awareness.

examples.japanese: {記憶|きおく}が{薄|うす}れてきた。
examples.english: My memory has started to fade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}が{経|た}つ→時間が経つ：24138_jikangatatsu⟧⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧{記憶|きおく}が{薄|うす}れていく。
examples.english: As time passes, memories fade away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{震災|しんさい}→震災：14610_shinsai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{記憶|きおく}が{薄|うす}れないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{追悼|ついとう}{式|しき}→追悼式：24788_tsuitoushiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A memorial ceremony is held every year so that the memory of the earthquake disaster does not fade.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧ (memory) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ (subject marker) + ⟦{薄|うす}れる→薄れる：14107_usureru⟧ (to thin, to fade). The verb ⟦{薄|うす}れる→薄れる：14107_usureru⟧ conveys the image of something becoming thinner or lighter, like color fading. It captures the gradual, natural loss of clarity in memories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記憶|きおく}が{薄|うす}れていく: memory gradually fades
- {記憶|きおく}が{薄|うす}れないうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: while the memory is still fresh
- {記憶|きおく}が{薄|うす}れないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: so that the memory doesn't fade

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧: memory disappears — stronger than fading; suggests complete loss
- ⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to forget — the active verb for forgetting; ⟦{薄|うす}れる→薄れる：14107_usureru⟧ emphasizes the gradual process rather than the result
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{曖昧|あいまい}→曖昧：08051_aimai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: memory becomes vague — focuses on loss of precision rather than intensity
